panels.rationale: Fluoroscopic cystogram in a patient with urofacial syndrome demonstrates a markedly trabeculated bladder with diverticular outpouchings and the described Christmas-tree appearance, consistent with a specific manifestation of the target disease.

panels.figure_caption: The trabeculated bladder wall with few diverticular outpouchings exhibiting a Christmas tree appearance.
in_text_mentions: der wall without associated hydronephrosis on either side. Fluoroscopic cystogram revealed a trabeculated wall with few diverticular outpouchings showing a Christmas tree appearance. No VUR was seen (Figure 2). Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the spine was unremarkable. Urodynamic study showed small bladder capacity with mild detrusor contraction during filling without leak and being unable to void without a catheter.
